questions.cardText:
[Psychology] Which of the following is the most predictive of job performance?
A. Standardized tests
B. Job interviews
C. Years of experience
Answer: A. Research has consistently shown that cognitive ability, often measured through standardized tests, is the strongest predictor of job performance. While interviews are commonly used, different interviewers often rate the same candidate very differently, making interviews unreliable.
questions.de: Welches Merkmal – meist mit standardisierten Tests gemessen – ist laut den klassischen Metaanalysen der Personalauswahl der stärkste einzelne Prädiktor für Arbeitsleistung?
questions.en: According to the classic meta-analyses of personnel selection, which trait — usually measured by standardized tests — is the strongest single predictor of job performance?

timeline.labelEn: Schmidt and Hunter's meta-analysis of 85 years of research names general mental ability the best predictor of job performance
timeline.labelDe: Die Metaanalyse von Schmidt und Hunter über 85 Jahre Forschung nennt die allgemeine kognitive Fähigkeit den besten Prädiktor für Arbeitsleistung

questions.notes: Dated premise: Schmidt & Hunter (1998) ranked general mental ability first, but Sackett et al. (2022, "Revisiting meta-analytic estimates of validity in personnel selection") corrected for range-restriction overcorrection and lowered that estimate, putting structured interviews at the top; unstructured interviews remain weak. The question is framed on the classic finding.

questions.cardText:
[Zoology] What can sharks sense that humans cannot?
A. Infrared light
B. Electrical fields
C. Radiation
Answer: B. Sharks have a special sensory system that allows them to detect the electrical fields created by other animals.
questions.de: Was können Haie mit ihren Lorenzinischen Ampullen wahrnehmen, was Menschen nicht können?
questions.en: What can sharks sense with their ampullae of Lorenzini that humans cannot?

timeline.labelEn: The ampullae of Lorenzini are identified as sense organs for electric fields
timeline.labelDe: Die Lorenzinischen Ampullen werden als Sinnesorgane für elektrische Felder erkannt
